quote: (g) If at any time an Event of Default with respect to a party has occurred and is then continuing the other party (the "non-Defaulting Party") may exercise its rights of termination under Clause 9 of the Facility Agreement. The provisions of section 6 (Early Termination; Close-Out Netting) will not apply to either party.
correct_answer: Neither party: the Schedule makes no Automatic Early Termination election as such, but expressly disapplies all of Section 6 (which contains Automatic Early Termination in 6(a)) as to both parties.
reason: The Schedule states that Section 6 (Early Termination), the home of Automatic Early Termination, will not apply to either party, so 'neither' is what the document states, whereas NONE (nothing stated) understates an explicit disapplication.
